name: Mara Teca
personality: rarely emotional but deeply anxious internally
daily_routine: coordinating with Doran on supply limits
checking humidity, pests, and spoilage risks
planning festival rations with temple requirements

goals.public_goal: Ensure no famine occurs and maintain stable food reserves year-round while preventing waste and spoilage
goals.hidden_goal: Build hidden surplus reserves unknown to leadership
goals.deep_goal: Prevent another crisis like the post–Night of Ash shortages

beliefs: Hunger reveals the truth about society
A village survives because someone says 'no'
Celebrations are dangerous if not controlled
People forget famine faster than they should
